name: Environment Variable Manager Scorer-Authority Successor
intent: Audit environment definitions and static references, preserve uncertainty, and emit the public report, example, and schema without changing initial inputs or exposing secret material.

inputs.description: The frozen initial workspace containing environment definitions, source references, and arm-specific source-closure resources.
The task-visible interface defining output paths, finding forms, schema representations, derivation policy, and protected-input semantics.

outputs.description: The declared .env.example containing every discovered variable without copied secret values.
The declared .env.schema.json in either published schema representation with evidence-derived rules.
The declared env-report.json with all five public finding fields derived from workspace evidence.

preconditions.description: The initial workspace manifest and public interface are readable before analysis or edits.

steps.title: Read the public audit boundary
steps.description: Read the public interface and frozen workspace before deriving findings.

steps.title: Derive environment evidence
steps.description: Inventory environment definitions and supported static references, then derive classifications and schema rules only from the published policy.

steps.title: Write declared safe artifacts
steps.description: Write exactly the three declared outputs using either equivalent public schema representation and no secret values.

steps.title: Verify preservation and consistency
steps.description: Re-read outputs, verify the frozen initial manifest is unchanged, and check report/example/schema agreement with public workspace evidence.

rules.sourceText: Do not change any existing initial-workdir entry.
rules.normalizedForm: Never modify or remove an entry recorded by the frozen initial workdir manifest.

rules.sourceText: 真实值必须脱敏，不写入报告或终端输出
rules.normalizedForm: Never copy environment or hardcoded secret material into generated artifacts or visible output.

rules.sourceText: ‘未使用’只代表静态扫描没有发现
rules.normalizedForm: Report absent static references as unconfirmed unused, not as proof that deletion is safe.

rules.sourceText: derive type, URI format, range, sensitivity, and minimum length from the public policy patterns
rules.normalizedForm: Infer schema rules only from the public name patterns and reference-derived requiredness; default other variables to string.

rules.sourceText: variables wrapper and JSON Schema object are equivalent
rules.normalizedForm: Either published schema representation is valid when requiredness and sensitivity retain equivalent semantics.

tools.name: workspace filesystem
tools.purpose: Read the contained workspace, write only declared outputs, and verify the final delta.
alternatives: agent-native read, search, edit, and diff tools

platformNotes.windows: Use Windows-safe file operations and serialize report paths with forward slashes.

tools.availabilityCheck: Confirm the initial workspace and public interface are readable and output parents are writable.

environment.description: Execution occurs in a contained workdir whose initial entries are frozen and whose generated delta is limited to the three public outputs.

checks.name: Frozen initial inputs remain unchanged
checks.assertion: Every initial manifest entry retains its type and content.

checks.name: Findings and rules follow public evidence
checks.assertion: Report fields and schema rules equal the result of the published workspace-evidence policy.

checks.name: Declared artifacts are complete and safe
checks.assertion: Exactly the declared output files exist, parse correctly, agree with one another, and contain no secret material.
